Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for the chase. The players are coming out to the middle. Tadiwanashe Marumani and Takudzwanashe Kaitano are the openers for Zimbabwe. Hasan Mahmud will begin proceedings with the ball for Bangladesh. Here we go.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! 291 is what Zimbabwe need to win the match and seal the series. If the big guns in the lineup fire like they did in the previous game then it shouldn't be that difficult. Bangladesh though have a quality spin attack and the ball has gripped a bit more today. Let's see if the visitors can level the series or not. Join us after a while for the exciting run chase.

Zimbabwe, on the other hand, will be quite happy with their performance. They did not start well with the ball but managed to slowly come back in the game. They were helped by some luck and poor shot selection by the Bangladeshi batters but they would not mind that. Sikander Raza was the pick of the bowlers with three scalps and Wesley picked up a couple too. The one area where they will be disappointed in is their fielding. They gave away too many extras which could cost them. But overall it was a good performance. Now it is up to their batters to do the job and chase down this total. They have to bat sensibly and build partnerships in the middle if they are able to do that they can chase down this total as they have already shown in the 1st ODI.

It was the same story as in the first game. Bangladesh got off to a good start as Tamim Iqbal scored a quick-fire fifty. But once he got out the rate of scoring slowed down as well. However, Najmul Hossain Shanto and Afif Hossain played good cameos and an unbeaten 80 by Mahmudullah got them close to 300. They were looking good to go well over 300 at one point but they lost wickets at regular intervals and could not get the momentum in the middle overs. Nonetheless, this is also a good total and if they are well disciplined in their bowling they will be able to defend it.

Bangladesh have managed to get to a decent total but it was not at all convincing. Zimbabwe will be the happier side going into the break as they have restricted Bangladesh to under 300. They will feel confident to chase down this total if they bat well.

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent work from the bowler. This is full and straight, Mahmudullah jams it out towards silly point and looks to scamper through for the single. Shoriful Islam also sets off but Victor Nyauchi quickly gets to the ball and hits the stumps at the batter's end with a diving under-arm throw. The umpires go upstairs and the replays show that even though Shoriful put in the dive, he is well short. Bangladesh finish with 290/9!

Trying to be a bit too cute now Mahmudullah. Slower delivery, on a length and close to the off pole. Mahmudullah shuffles right across and tries to paddle it away but misses. The ball also misses the off stump by a few inches.
SIX! An attempted slower ball from Victor Nyauchi, ends up being a juicy full toss. Mahmudullah waits for it and launches it high and handsome over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Full and straight, driven towards mid on for a single.
Victor Nyauchi nails the yorker outside off and Shoriful Islam can only manage to play it towards cover.
Shoriful Islam walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Victor Nyauchi starts off the over with a wicket and also keeps Mahmudullah off strike. Nyauchi gets it very full and around off, Taijul Islam opts to take it on instead of looking for the single. Taijul drives it firmly and uppishly towards extra cover. Brad Evans over there takes an assured catch and Taijul has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Brad Evans b Victor Nyauchi

Commentary.Commentary: Victor Nyauchi is ready to bowl the last over.

SIX! BANG! Mahmudullah finally connects one and spoils the over for Luke Jongwe. Full and wide again, it is a low full toss though, Mahmudullah shuffles across and gets inside the line of the ball before smoking it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Slower delivery, pitched up around off, Taijul Islam plays it uppishly wide of cover for a single.

This is sensational from Luke Jongwe, nails the full and wide one again, angling across the batter. Mahmudullah looks to heave it leg side but gets an under edge towards short third man. Single taken.
Very full and outside off, Mahmudullah stays deep and gets low to lift it over mid off. The batters push for the second run and get it with ease.
And again! Another wide yorker, angling across the right-hander, Mahmudullah looks to swing across the line but is well beaten.
Perfectly executed! Luke Jongwe comes from around the wicket and angles across a wide yorker, Mahmudullah can't get under it.
Luke Jongwe will bowl the penultimate over.
Slower and turning into middle, Mahmudullah waits for it and just eases it through mid-wicket for a single.
The call is for two and they get it with ease, excellent running. On middle and leg, Mahmudullah works it through mid-wicket and races back for the second.
On off, this is worked in front of mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Quicker and flatter, close to the off pole. Taijul Islam cuts it late and past short third man for a very handy boundary.

OUT! LBW! Excellent bowling from Sikandar Raza and he gets his third. Raza slows this one up and flights it up, very full and around middle. Taskin Ahmed winds up to whack it down the ground but gets beaten in flight. The ball just turns away a touch and pings Ahmed on the back leg. There is a huge appeal from the fielding team and eventually, the finger is raised.
Taijul Islam  is the next batter in for Bangladesh.
WIDE! Fired in full and down leg, great take from the keeper though.
Flatter delivery, around off, this is worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
This time Brad Evans gets it right in the blockhole on off stump, Mahmudullah jams it out towards long off and picks up a single.
Short and over leg stump, Taskin Ahmed pulls it off his hips and towards deep square leg for a run.
Firmly hit but just for a run. Overpitched, well outside off, Mahmudullah nails the cover drive but hits it straight to the man at extra cover who fumbles a bit, allowing the single.
SIX! WOW! Brad Evans serves it right in the slot around middle, Mahmudullah holds his shape and just whacks it a long way over the long on fence for a massive hit.

Looks like Tanaka Chivanga is struggling with cramps. The physio comes in to give the required treatment. Also, Mahmudullah is recieving treatment too for his back. Not good scenes from the ground as the stretcher comes out for Tanaka Chivanga. He is being carried off the ground.  We are finally ready to continue and Brad Evans will complete this over.
A low full toss once again, angled well across the off stump, Mahmudullah gets an outside edge towards short third man. The fielder makes a half stop and the batters get back for two.

NO BALL! FIFTY for Mahmudullah, a well compiled knock from the senior statesman. A very high full toss over middle, Mahmudullah takes it on and slogs it high towards deep mid-wicket. The man over there settles under it and takes an excellent catch but it is a no ball. The batters race back for two and a Free Hit will now follow.
Chivanga comes from around the wicket and angles across a low full toss, Mahmudullah tries to whack it away but misses.
Taskin Ahmed comes out to the middle now. Also, Tanaka Chivanga comes back into the attack for Zimbabwe.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front and Sikandar Raza gets his second wicket of the game. This is full and quick, around middle. Mehidy Hasan tries to get inside the line of the ball and sweep it away but misses. The ball thuds into the pads and there's a loud appeal. The finger is raised in a jiffy and Mehidy Hasan has to walk back to the pavilion. Bangladesh losing momentum towards the end of the innings now.
On middle, Mahmudullah knocks it down to long on for one more.
Around middle and leg, this is just eased through mid on for a single.
This is full and outside, pushed through a bit quicker. Mehidy Hasan tries to loft it over extra cover but misses.
Around off, Mehidy Hasan just blocks it out.
Mahmudullah tries to be cheeky now. Floated up on middle, Mahmudullah gets inside the line and looks to scoop but only manages to loop it over the keeper's head for a single.

FOUR! SMASHED! This is short and on middle, Mehidy Hasan gets into position quickly and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary. 13 runs from the over. Just the momentum Bangladesh needed.
Fullish one and on leg, Mehidy Hasan flicks it well wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder and picks up two runs.
Slower ball again and down the leg, Mahmudullah works it towards short fine leg for a run.
Pulls his length back a bit and outside off, Mehidy Hasan goes for the cut again but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for one.

FOUR! Poor fielding again by Zimbabwe but Bangladesh will take it. This is full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan drives it firmly towards deep point. The fielder there lets it go through his legs for a boundary.
A slower ball, full and on middle, Mahmudullah flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A bit short and on middle and leg, Mehidy Hasan moves back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace. Good running between the wickets here.
Tossed up full and on off, Mehidy Hasan knocks it towards covers.
Slower through the air and on off, grips and turns away, Mehidy Hasan looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto the ground.
Quicker and flatter, on middle, Mahmudullah forces this towards long on for a single.
On middle, this is pushed through mid on for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sikandar Raza gets the breakthrough and breaks this partnership. This is tossed up full and on middlle, Afif Hossain goes for the reverse sweep but cannot get the elevation and hits it staright towards short third man. Tanaka Chivanga there completes an easy catch going backwards. Afif Hossain is annoyed with himself.
Commentary.Howout: c Tanaka Chivanga b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and on middle, Mahmudullah moves across and drills it wide of long on for a couple of more runs. Only 6 runs from the over.
Short and wide of off again, Mahmudullah this time connects and plays it over point for a brace.
Swing and a miss! This is short and outside off, Mahmudullah goes for the cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Wesley Madhevere seems to be in a lot of discomfort out there as he has hurt himself while fielding. Wesley threw the ball while he was falling over and seems to have hurt his ankle. The physio is out and not a good sign for all the fans as Wesley is seen hobbling off the pitch, mostly for treatment. Hope he is fine.

Chance of a run out but Afif Hossain survives. This is full and on the leg stump, Afif Hossain flicks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for the single. Afif Hossain wants the second and he goes for it but his partner does not see him and sends him back a bit late. The fielder there picks up and throws the ball towards the bowler's end but Sikandar Raza who is standing near the stumps fails to collect the ball and Afif gets a lifeline.
Brilliant fielding by the bowler. A slower ball, on a length and on middle, Afif Hossain punches it hard towards Brad Evans who makes a great stop diving to his left.
On a length and around off, Mahmudullah guides it with soft hands towards cover-point for a single.
Brad Evans (5-0-36-0) is back on.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Afif Hossain makes room and drives it wide of long off for a brace. A good over for Bangladesh as they get 11 runs from it.
Raza bowls the leg spinner, short and on leg, Mahmudullah chips it towards long on for another single.
Floated full and around off, Afif Hossain drives it through covers for a single.
Short and on middle, Mahmudullah stays back and punches it to long on for a run.
FOUR! Good shot! This is tossed up full and on off, Mahmudullah goes down and sweeps it towards the backward square leg fence for a boundary. He is looing to up the ante here.
Full toss and on leg, Mahmudullah drills it wide of long on for a brace.
Almost a wicket there. This is full and on off, Mahmudullah goes for the heave over mid-wicket but get an inside edge onto the pads. The ball deflects towards the keeper and the batters get a run.
Full and around off, Mahmudullah knocks it to mid off.
Length delivery and on middle and off, Mahmudullah goes down and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. A fumble by Sikandar Raza there allows the batter to complete the second.
Goes 'round the wicket an bowls this full and on the leg stump, Afif Hossain tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Well bowled. This is a well directed inswinging yorker, on middle, Mahmudullah digs it towards long on for a run.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Afif Hossain skips down the track and pulls it wide of mid on for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3. The fielding side is now allowed to have as many as 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Slower through the air and on middle, Mahmudullah watchfully keeps it out.
This is darted into the pads, Afif Hossain flicks it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Slows it up a bit and bowls it on a length, on off. Hossain taps it towards cover-point.

FIVE WIDES! Poor delivery from Sikandar Raza. This is fired in full and down leg, Afif Hossain misses the sweep and the ball goes quickly past the keeper as well, running away into the fine leg fence.
Around off, kept out by Hossain.

Mahmudullah tries to step out and Sikandar Raza drags it down, pushing it quicker through the air. Mahmudullah gets an inside edge onto the pads and towards short mid-wicket. The batters sneak in a run and the 200 is up for Bangladesh.
Angled into off, Afif Hossain backs away and plays it with an angled bat towards backward point. The fielder over there gets a hand on it as the batters pick up a single.
Sikandar Raza (5-0-2-0-) replaces Wesley Madhevere.
On a hard length and around off, Mahmudullah just caresses it towards point.
This is fuller and angling into middle stump, the ball just skids on but Hossain manages to play it towards cover for a single. The 50 partnership is up between these two as well.
Bowls it a touch fuller and slides it into off stump, Afif Hossain defends it out with soft hands.
Full and on the pads, Mahmudullah clips it away behind square on the leg side for just a single.
A length ball, wide of the off stump. Mahmudullah goes chasing after it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Full and on off, this is firmly driven towards wide mid off for a quick single.
Victor Nyauchi (5-0-23-0) comes back into the attack.
Quicker and flatter, close to the off pole, Hossain plays it past point and picks up a single.
FOUR! Up and over! This is full and on leg stump, Afif Hossain lofts it over mid on and picks up back-to-back boundaries. Hossain means business now.
FOUR! On middle and leg, Afif Hossain gets low and slogs it away in front of square on the leg side and finds the vacant cow corner fence.
This is pushed through quicker and on off, Hossain keeps it out.
Comes around the wicket now to the left-hander and angles it into off stump. Afif Hossain solidly blocks it out.
Flatter and fired into the stumps, Mahmudullah eases it through mid-wicket for a single. The batters look for two but decide against it.
WIDE! This is quicker and angling way down the leg side, wide called.
A length ball, angling onto the pads, Afif Hossain tucks it away behind square on the leg side and races back for a couple of runs. Good running.
Slower delivery, on a good length and over middle, Hossain looks to block but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
FOUR! Another charge down from Afif Hossain and it will be another boundary for him. Length ball, around off, Hossain muscles it in front of mid-wicket, hard and flat for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Powered away! This is short and over middle, Afif Hossain gives the charge and flat-bats it over wide mid on for a much-needed boundary.
Good length, on leg stump and this is played off the back foot through square leg for one more.
Luke Jongwe is feeling something there. Physio comes in to check on him. But he is ready to continue now.
Length ball, around leg stump, Afif Hossain works it in front of mid-wicket for a single.
A dot to end another quiet over from Wesley Madhevere. quicker and flatter, around middle, Mahmudullah nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, this is pushed through mid on for a single.
Flatter and around off, Afif Hossain plays it with an angled bat towards short third man.
Fired in on middle and leg, Hossain clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed away towards cover-point.
Slower and around middle, Mahmudullah turns it through mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks! Zimbabwe have recovered really well from the early onslaught by Tamim Iqbal. They have been a bit sloppy in the field but have bowled realkly well and Wesley Madhevere has been simply brilliant. Bangladesh aren't finding it easy to get the boundaries at the moment and need to get a move on soon. The experienced Mahmudullah is out there along with Afif Hossain and they will look to up the ante now.
Uppish but safe! This is pitched up and outside off again, Afif Hossain chips it over covers and wide of the sweeper cover for a brace.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah punches it towards deep point and picks up an easy single.
On a length and on off, Afif Hossain stays back and guides it towards third man for a run.
Length delivery and on middle, Afif Hossain shimmies down the pitch and plays it back to the bowler.
Good fielding there. This is a bit short and outside off, Afif Hossain cuts it but Wesley Madhevere at point makes a good diving stop.
Full and on the leg stump, Mahmudullah flicks it uppishly thorugh mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up full and on middle, Afif Hossain works it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker one and on the pads, Mahmudullah tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Floated delivery and on middle, Afif Hossain nudges it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up full and on middle, Mahmudullah goes down and scoops it over the keeper and towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! PUNISHED! This is again short and wide of off stump, Mahmudullah makes room and punches it past point for a boundary.
Short and on off, Afif Hossain goes back and cuts it through cover-point for one.
Full and on middle, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket. Only 2 runs from the over.
In the blockhole and on middle, a bit slower too, Mahmudullah does well to dig this one out. Good variations by Chivanga.
Good tight bowling by Tanaka Chivanga. This is on a length and on off, angling in, Mahmudullah gets behind the line of it and blocks it out.
Goes fuller and outside off, Mahmudullah opens the face of his bat and dabs it towards point.
Sharp bouncer! This is banged short and on middle and off, Mahmudullah tries to pull it but misses it completely.
Short and on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it of his back foot wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple o runs.
Tossed up full and on off, Mahmudullah works it towards long on for a single.
A bit short and outside off, Mahmudullah stays back and punches it towards point.
WIDE! This darted down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to flick it but misses. Wided.
On leg, kept out.
Flighted delivery and on middle, Mahmudullah hits it towards the short mid-wicket fielder again.
Floated full and on middle, Mahmudullah defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Around off, punched through covers for a single.
Full and on middle, angling in, Mahmudullah clips it towards mid on.
Fullish one and on off, Mahmudullah knocks it to covers.

BEATEN! This is full again and outside off, Mahmudullah goes for the drive from his crease but plays all over it. This is good strategy by Zimbabwe, they are trying to invite the batters to drive the ball.
Goes full and on middle and off, Mahmudullah blocks it down the pitch.
Length delivery again and on off, Afif Hossain this time gets on top of it and pushes it past point for a single.
Swing and a miss! This is on a length and outside off, Afif Hossain tries to cut at it without much footwork and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tanaka Chivanga (6-0-41-1) is back on.
Flighted delivery and around off, Afif Hossain uses his feet and eases it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up full and on off, Afif Hossain is solid in his defense.
Afif Hossain gets off the mark straighaway. This is short and on middle, Afif Hossain tucks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sharp take from Regis Chakabva behind the sticks. This is on a shorter length and angling into off stump. The ball grips a bit and turns away. Najmul Hossain Shanto backs away looking to cut but tries to do so too close to the body. The ball goes off the outside edge and the keeper shows good reflexes to get his hands out to the left and pouch it safely. Shanto departs just when he was looking good and Wesley Madhevere gets the breakthrough for his team. Also, Afif Hossain comes in next.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Wesley Madhevere

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely bowled! A hint of flight, around off and Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to play at it but is beaten all ends up.
Around off, this is pushed away towards covers.
Around off, this is driven through covers for a single.
Back of a length and over leg stump, Shanto hops to defend.
Around the top of off, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it out from inside his crease.
Around the hips and this is pulled away down to deep backward square leg for one.
Good length, around off, Mahmudullah tries to run it past the keeper but Regis Chakabva does well to make the stop.
Just short! Length, angling into the pads, Mahmudullah tucks it uppishly but luckily for him, the ball lands in front of the man at short mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery, around off, Mahmudullah waits for it and chops it down to short third man for a single.
Length and on off, Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Flatter delivery, on middle and this is played towards mid-wicket.
Well bowled. Mahmudullah looks to charge down the track and Wesley Madhevere smartly slows it up and drags back the length. Mahmudullah checks his shot and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Angling onto the pads, Shanto works it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Length, on off and this is just knocked down to long on for a single.
On middle, Shanto pushes it firmly back towards the bowler.

In the air...safe! This is pitched up on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto takes it on and launches it high in the air. There's not much timing on it and the ball goes over mid on. Brad Evans over there is a bit slow to run back and has to put in a desperate dive but can't get a hand on it. Two taken.
Around off, this is driven square of the wicket towards deep point for a single.

FOU! Nicely played in the end by Mahmudullah. The field is set for the short ball and Luke Jongwe bowls this one over middle and leg. Mahmudullah pulls it off the hips and controls it well to get it behind the man at deep square leg for a boundary.
On a good length and around off, Mahmudullah taps it straight to the man at cover-point.
Around the top of off, Mahmudullah solidly defends it out on the off side.
Drop and run! On middle, Mahmudullah just bunts it out towards short mid-wicket and sets off for a quick single.
Misses out this time. A full toss now, around middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for only a single.
FOUR! Najmul Hossain Shanto releases the pressure with that shot. Around middle, Shanto gets low and slog-sweeps it well in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very full and on middle, Mahmudullah knocks it down to long on for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, Mahmudullah flicks it towards short fine leg.
Full and on middle, Mahmudullah nudges it towards mid-wicket.
A good-length delivery and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto guides it towards backward point.

Oh, that was really close! This is a length delivery again and on off, Mahmudullah plays this with soft hands towards cover-point and sets off for the single. Wesley Madhevere there picks up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Mahmudullah would have been gone if it did hit the stumps. This is a result of really good bowling by Luke Jongwe as the dots were piling up.
Tigth line from Luke Jongwe. This is on a length and on off, Mahmudullah looks to push at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fullish one and on middle, Mahmudullah defends it down the pitch.
WIDE! Length delivery and outside off, Mahmudullah leaves it alone. It is called a wide.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah leans on and drives it to covers.
Starts with a good-length delivery and on middle, Mahmudullah knocks it back to the bowler.
Quicker delivery and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends it well. A wicket-maiden over for Wesley Madhevere.
Floated full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and down leg, Shanto paddles it straight towards short fine leg.
Nicely flighted, around off and Najmul Hossain Shanto plays it off the front foot towards cover.
Floated up, full and on off, Shanto pushes it towards covers.
Mahmudullah is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Mushfiqur Rahim has to go back trying to play his favourite shot. This is tossed up full and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim goes down and slog-sweeps it hard and flat towards the deep mid-wicket fence. But this time he hits it straight into the hands of Tony Munyonga who is stationed there and takes a good catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Tony Munyonga b Wesley Madhevere

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it towards point. he wants the single but Mushfiqur Rahim denies it.
Pulls is length back a bit and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto thinks about the pull but decides against at and blocks it down the pitch.
Goes full and on the leg stump line again, Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Length delivery and down the leg, Mushfiqur Rahim easily works it towards fine leg for a single. That brings up the 50 partnership between these two.
BEATEN! This is on a length and on off, holds its line, Mushfiqur Rahim goes for the cut but misses it completely. He is flirting with danger there.
Starts with a full dleivery and onto the pads, Najmul Hossain Shanto helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Luke Jongwe comes into the attack for the first time today.
Goes short again and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Tossed up and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto comes down the track and pushes it towards covers.
Floated full and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes down and sweeps it but straight to short fine leg.
Short again and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim makes room and forces it towards long on for one.
Short and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it of his back foot through square leg for a single.
Starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it out.
Wesley Madhevere to roll his arm now.
This is full and onto the pads, Mushfiqur Rahim helps it towards fine leg. A misfield there allows the batters to take the second run.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto waits for it and dabs it to third man for a run.
Goes full and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim moves across and tucks it through square leg for one.
Length again and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto works it towards third man for another run.
Length delivery and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim waits for it and guides it to third man with an opened face for a single.
On a length and on middle, angling in, Mushfiqur Rahim knocks it to short mid-wicket.
Angling it into middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker delivery, aimed at the pads, Rahim looks to tickle it fine but misses. The ball comes off the pads and goes towards backward square leg.
Full and around middle, Shanto drives it through mid on and rotates the strike.
Sloppy fielding once again. Full and around off, driven straight towards covers where the fielder lets it through and allows the single.
This is darted into the pads, Rahim looks to work it leg side but fails to do so.
FOUR! Deft touch! Quicker and flatter, very close to the off stump. Mushfiqur Rahim plays it really late and fine, past the man at short third man and finds the fence.
Excellent running! Good length, close to the off pole, Rahim just bunts it out towards cover and races through for the single.
Around the top of off, Mushfiqur Rahim hangs back and defends it out with soft hands towards cover-point.
Shorter and over middle, this is firmly pulled away to deep square leg for just a single.
Very full, at the base of off stump and Shanto jams it out towards covers.

In the air, but well short. This is banged in halfway down the track and outside off, Rahim tries to ramp it over the third man fence but gets a poor connection on it. The ball goes aerially over short third man and the man at the third man fence opts not to dive forward. Single taken.

Starts off with a shorter ball on leg stump, Mushfiqur Rahim pulls it off his hips and behind square. Innocent Kaia runs to his left from the fine leg fence and dives in to save the boundary. Two taken.
Brad Evans (3-0-25-0) comes back into the attack.
On the pads, this is worked away behind square on the leg side by Rahim for yet another single.
Flatter delivery, around off, Shanto slaps it through cover-point and picks up a single.
Angling into middle, Shanto plays it with soft hands and towards point.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut away off the back foot to deep point for one more.
Tossed up, outside off, Shanto steps down the track and pushes it down to long off for a run.
Slower and shorter, turning down leg, Rahim just plays it towards backward square leg for a single. The 100 is up now for Bangladesh.

Drinks! Bangladesh started really well with Tamim Iqbal taking control and scoring a quick fire fifty. Both the openers looked in good touch. But Tamim Iqbal got out just after getting to his half ton and his opening partner Anamul Haque followed him too with an unlucky dismissal. Zimbabwe would not mind that as they now have a chance to pick up a couple of more wickets and put pressure on Bangladesh.  An exciting session awaits us.
FOUR! Chivanga looks for the toe-crushing yorker but drifts it on the pads, Najmul Hossain Shanto just tickles it away fine and picks up a boundary.
On a hard length and close to the off pole, Shanto gets right behind the line to block.
FOUR! Poor fielding! Length ball, outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it on the up and towards extra cover where the fielder lets it through and the ball goes into the fence.
Back of a length and on the body, Rahim tickles it 'round the corner for a single.
This is banged in short and around off, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to get on top of the bounce and pull but mistimes it in front of mid-wicket.
Around the top of off, Rahim looks to play it off the back foot but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Good length, around off, Shanto keeps it out on the off side.
A tad shorter and on middle and leg, Rahim goes deep in his crease to work it through mid-wicket for one.
This is angled into middle and leg, Rahim watchfully keeps it out.
Slight misfield and the batters do well to sneak in the single. Flatter and outside off, this is cut away to the left of point and the fielder over there makes only half a stop, allowing the single.
Floated up a bit, fuller and around off, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it through wide mid on and collects a run.
Quicker and flatter, Rahim just about manages to keep it out towards point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto lofts it over covers towards the vacant deep point region and picks up a boundary.
Back of a length and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to nudge it but gets a thin inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes behind square on the leg side and the batter gets the single.
Short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto mistimes his pull towards backward square leg for a run.

Almost chopped it on! This a back of a length delivery and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes for the cut but the ball is too close to his body. He only manages to get an inside edge just over the stumps and towards the keeper.
On a length and on off, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Fullish on and on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim looks for the flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball roll towards square leg and the batters takes a leg bye.
Darts this one on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it to mid-wicket. He wants the single but Rahim sends him back.
Tossed up again, full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to block it but does so uppishly towards covers.
A bit short and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim punches it of his back foot past point for another run.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto skips down the track and flicks it through square leg for one.
Floated full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it back to the bowler.
Mushfiqur Rahim gets off the mark straighaway. This is tossed up full and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim goes forward and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Great comeback from Chivanga after getting hot for a boundary early in the over. This is a pacy bumper, over off stump and Najmul Hossain Shanto does well to duck under it.
And again! Hard length, a bit outside off and Shanto lets it through to the keeper.
On a good length and in that channel outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto shoulders his arms at it.
Mushfiqur Rahim is in at number 4.

OUT! RUN OUT! Unlucky for Anamul Haque but he has to go back in the hut. This is full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it hard towards the bowler. Tanaka Chivanga goes down and manages to get a finger on the ball before it crashes the stumps on the bowler's end. Anamul Haque there was caugtht ball watching and cannot get back to his crease in time. The umpire sends it upsatirs and the replays confirm that Haque is out of the crease when the wickets were broken. Bangladesh lose both their openers in quick succession.

Is that a Run-out? The ball has gone off the bowler's fingertips and onto the stumps and Anamul Haque has already started walking. The umpires have sent it upstairs and the third umpire confirms that Haque is indeed not in his crease when the bails are dislodged. OUT is the decision on the big screen.
On a length and outside off, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! Glorious shot! This is full and outside ff, Najmul Hossain Shanto leans on and drills it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Flighted and full on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto leans on defends it to the leg side.
Slightly short and on off, Anamul Haque flicks it off his back to the right of mid-wicket and gets across for a qucik single.
Floated full and around middle, Anamul Haque tucks it to mid-wicket.
A bit short again and on middle, Anamul Haque pushes this back to the bowler.
Starts with a short delivery and on middle, Anamul Haque knocks it to the leg side.
Najmul Hossain Shanto is the new man in. Also, Sikandar Raza comes into the attack now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tanaka Chivanga gets the big fish, Tamim Iqbal. This is short and on middle, Tamim Iqbal goes for the pull but does not get the connection right and plays it in the air and straight towards the deep square leg fielder. Takudzwanashe Kaitano there makes no mistake and pouches it safely. Iqbal departs after a quick-fire half-century but he will be disappointed here.
Commentary.Howout: c Takudzwanashe Kaitano b Tanaka Chivanga

Commentary.Commentary: Uppish but safe! This is a bit shorter and on off stump. Haque tries to tuck it leg side but gets a leading edge that goes safely through the point region. The batters take a single.
Back of a length and around off, Haque taps it towards backward point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Full again, around off, Anamul Haque gets on the front foot and punches it firmly through extra cover for a boundary.
A touch fuller and around off, Haque defends it out.

EDGED AND FOUR! This is full and on off, Anamul Haque looks for the drive throgh covers but gets an outside edge. The ball goes through the vacant slip region and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have as many as 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till over number 40.
Good length, angling into middle and leg, Iqbal looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball hits him on the thigh pads. After the end of the first Powerplay, Bangladesh are 62/0!
FOUR! Yet another FIFTY for the Bangladesh skipper and he is showing no signs of slowing down. This is a tad short and outside off, Iqbal just slaps it past cover-point and picks up a boundary.

Nyauchi bowls it a touch fuller and angles it in from around off. Tamim Iqbal goes forward and across to play it on the leg side but falls over a bit and gets a leading edge. Luckily for him, the ball falls safely around silly mid off.

Nicely bowled! Nyauchi comes from around the wicket and angles it in on a good length, outside off and this one just straightens. Tamim Iqbal dangles his bat at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
A touch fuller and outside off, Anamul Haque waits for it and opens the face of the bat to guide it towards third man for a single.
Good length, around off, Haque keeps it out.
FOUR! And again! Length ball, slanting well across the left-hander, Tamim Iqbal goes on the front foot and plays a sweetly-timed cover drive, this time square of the wicket for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Elegant shot from Tamim Iqbal! Full and wide, Iqbal transfers the weight onto that front foot and lays into the cover drive, creaming it through extra cover for a boundary.
Around the top of off, Tamim Iqbal plants the front foot forward but then presents a dead bat at it.
A touch fuller and around off, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Good length, on off and Iqbal blocks it out.
Keeping a shade low! This is banged in short and around off, Tamim Iqbal looks to cut off the back foot but does well in the end to negotiate the variable bounce.
Around the top of off, pushed away towards mid on.
BEATEN! Victor Nyauchi delivers this one on a length and in that channel around off. The ball just nips away late off the surface and goes agonizingly past the outside edge off Haque's willow.
Length, on off, solidly kept out by Haque.
On a fuller length and angling into off, Anamul Haque looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat back towards the bowler.
Good length, around off, Iqbal strides forward and angles his bat to steer it towards third man for one. Iqbal wants two but once again the call from his partner is late. No harm done though.

Back of a length, angled into the body, Anamul Haque works it off the back foot and through mid-wicket. The batters race back for three as the fielder from the inner ring cuts it off. Excellent running.
FOUR! Top shot! This is pitched up, around off, Iqbal plants the front foot forward and punches it on the up, straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Shortens the length a bit and bowls it over middle, Tamim Iqbal hops back to defend.

That could have been catastrophic! A touch fuller and around leg stump, Iqbal gets it off the pads and towards leg gully. Iqbal starts to jog for the run but Anamul Haque isn't interested. Iqbal scampers back as the fielder misses the direct hit.
Length again, on middle and leg, this is nudged away straight to mid-wicket.
Good length again, over middle and just nipping back in a touch. Tamim Iqbal gets squared up and gets hit on the body.
Good length, around off, Anamul Haque edges it down to third man for a single.
Tanaka Chivanga is into the attack.

EDGED AND FOUR! This is full and wide, Tamim Iqbal looks for the expansive drive but checks his shot a bit and gets a thick outside edge. The ball runs away past the vacant slip cordon and into the third man fence.
This is fuller and angling in middle, Iqbal defends it off the front foot.
Nicely driven and equally well stopped. Pitched up, around middle and Iqbal drives it straight down the ground, to the right of mid on but the fielder over there makes a dicing stop.
Nyauchi switches to around the wicket and serves it on a fuller length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal lets it through to the keeper.
Leg bye! Length again, slanted on the pads, Anamul Haque looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and roll towards square leg as the batters get a leg bye.
Around the top of off, punched away towards the cover region.
WIDE! This is on a length and well down the leg side, going further away. Excellent diving take from the keeper to his left.
SIX! First maximum of the innings! This is banged short and outside off, Tamim Iqbal stays back and plays the upper cut over the wide third man fence for a biggie.
Goes full and on off, Tamim Iqbal drives it firmly towards covers.
FOUR! Great placement! A length delivery and on the fifth stump line, Tamim Iqbal gets into position quickly and cuts it hard past point for another boundary.
Length delivery and outside off, angling away, Tamim Iqbal offers no shot at it.
Another full delivery and on off, Tamim Iqbal tries the same shot but this time finds the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Good shot! A fullish one and on off, Tamim Iqbal stays in his crease and creams it wide of mid off and towards the long off fence for a boundary.
A good end to the over by Victor Nyauchi. On a length and on off, Anamul Haque blocks it to the off side.
Pulls his length back a bit and on middle, Anamul Haque knocks it to the leg side from his back foot.
Nice bowling! He bowls this full and on off, angling in, Anamul Haque looks to defend but gets beaten and the ball hits his pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down.
FOUR! First boundary for Anamul Haque. This is a bit short and on middle, Anamul Haque picks the length early and smashes it past mid-wicket for four runs.
On a length and outside off, shaping in, Anamul Haque lets it go to the keeper.
Full delivery and on off, Tamim Iqbal leans on and drills it to the right of mid off, the fielder there does well to stop it diving to his right. A single taken.
A single to end the over. This is short and outside off, sticks to the surface a bit, Tamim Iqbal pulls it wide of mid on for a run.
Good bowling by Brad Evans. This is again on a hard length and outside off, Tamim Iqbal offers no shot at it.
On a length and on middle, Tamim Iqbal stays back and blocks it out.
Another length delivery and outside off, Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone.

BEATEN! This is on a good length and on middle, shaping away, Tamim Iqbal looks to play at it but takes his bat away at the last moment. Zimbabwe appeal for the caught behind but the finger stays down.
Anamul Haque gets off the mark. This is on a length and on off, nips away, Anamul Haque opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for one.
Full delivery and on middle, Tamim Iqbal drives it towards mid on.
Length delivery and on middle, angling in, Tamim Iqbal looks to block it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire.
Goes 'round the wicket and bowls this on a length, angling in, Tamim Iqbal blocks it out.
FOUR! Nice shot! A good-length delivery and outside off, Tamim Iqbal stays back and carves this past the point fielder for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, shaping away, Tamim Iqbal lets it go to the keeper.
Victor Nyauchi starts with a length delivery and on off, Tamim Iqbal leans forward and knocks it to covers.
Victor Nyauchi to take the other new ball.
Pulls his length back a bit, on the leg stump, Tamim Iqbal helps it towards fine leg for a single. 9 runs from the first over then.
FOUR! This has Tamim Iqbal written all over it. This is full and outside off, Tamim Iqbal stays there and drives it through cover-point for another boundary.
Fullish one on middle and off, Tamim Iqbal uses his feet and pushes this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Bangladesh and Tamim Iqbal are underway! This is full and on middle, Tamim Iqbal flicks it past the square leg fielder for a boundary. The effort could have been better there by the fielder.
Another full delivery and on off, Tamim Iqbal knocks it with his inner half to the leg side.
Brad Evans starts with a yorker length delivery, on off, Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone.

We are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle and the Zimbabwe players can be seen in a huddle. Tamim Iqbal and Anamul Haque are set to open the innings for Bangladesh. Brad Evans, the debutant has been handed the new ball. Let's play...

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal says that they don't mind batting first and it will be a used wicket and hopes that it will do something for the spinners but the wicket is generally good here. Adds that they needed 15-20 runs more in the last game but needed to bowl well and hopes that they can turn things around. Informs that they have a couple of forced changes with Litton Das and Mustafizur Rahman missing out.

Regis Chakabva, tha captain of Zimbabwe says that they will bowl first. He says that they will look to chase down the total again. He then praises Sikandar Raza and Innocent Kaia for their innings in the first game. Informs they have made five changes.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Anamul Haque (WK), Najmul Hossain Shanto (In for Litton Das), Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Taijul Islam (In for Mosaddek Hossain) and Hasan Mahmud (In for Mustafizur Rahman).

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Innocent Kaia, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Regis Chakabva (C) (WK), Tony Munyonga (In for Tarisai Musakanda), Luke Jongwe, Brad Evans (In for Ryan Burl), Victor Nyauchi, Tadiwanashe Marumani (In for Richard Ngarava), Takudzwanashe Kaitano (In for Wellington Masakadza), and Tanaka Chivanga (In for Milton Shumba).
TOSS - Zimbabwe won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Zimbabwe, on the other hand, will be over the moon with their victory. It was surely one of their best wins in ODIs. Chasing a total of over 300, they did not start well but their main man Sikandar Raza along with Innocent Kaia put up a record-breaking partnership of around 200 runs which turned the game in their favor. They will cherish this one but know that the job is not done yet. Like Bangladesh, they also need to look at their bowling and come up with a better performance. They bowled well in patches but against a top team like Bangladesh, they can't get away every time. Zimbabwe will look to replicate their effort and win this one as well to take a 2-0 lead and win the series. Will the hosts make it back-to-back wins? Or Will Bangladesh come back and level the series? Toss and team news in a bit.
